form.label: Altiward overview
form.description: Who holds admin rights on your Macs, how elevations went over the period, and what needs a look, from the events Altiward sends (sourcetype altiward:ocsf). The same figures are on the Altiward console's Overview. "Without a grant" means admin rights that nobody granted through SAP Privileges.

search.query: index="$index$" sourcetype="altiward:ocsf" metadata.correlation_uid=* (unmapped.altiward.event_type="elevation.granted" OR unmapped.altiward.event_type="admin.out_of_band" OR unmapped.altiward.event_type="elevation.revoked" OR unmapped.altiward.event_type="elevation.expired_enforced" OR unmapped.altiward.event_type="admin.out_of_band_removed") | eval ev='unmapped.altiward.event_type', is_start=if(ev="elevation.granted" OR ev="admin.out_of_band", 1, 0) | eval start_time=if(is_start=1, _time, null()), end_time=if(is_start=0, _time, null()), exp=if(ev="elevation.granted", 'unmapped.altiward.expires_time' / 1000, null()), src=if(is_start=1, 'unmapped.altiward.source', null()), email='user.email_addr', uname='user.name' | stats min(start_time) as started max(end_time) as ended max(exp) as expires values(src) as src values(email) as email values(uname) as uname values(host) as mac by metadata.correlation_uid | where isnotnull(started) | eval src=mvindex(src, 0), mac=mvindex(mac, 0), source=case(src="privileges", "Privileges", src="out_of_band", "Without a grant"), person=if(isnotnull(email), mvindex(email, 0), mvindex(uname, 0)." on ".mac) | fields metadata.correlation_uid started ended expires source person mac

panel.title: Admins now, by where the rights came from

search.query: where isnull(ended) | stats count as People by source | append [| makeresults | eval source=split("Privileges,Without a grant", ","), People=0 | mvexpand source | fields source People] | stats sum(People) as People by source | eval order=case(source="Privileges", 1, source="Without a grant", 2) | sort order | fields - order | rename source as Source
where isnull(ended) AND isnotnull(expires) AND expires < now() | stats count

index="$index$" sourcetype="altiward:ocsf" class_uid=2004 finding_info.analytic.name="altiward.tamper.*" unmapped.altiward.detail.state!="detected" | stats latest(activity_id) as last by finding_info.uid host | where last=1 | stats dc(host) as Macs

index="$index$" sourcetype="altiward:ocsf" class_uid=2004 finding_info.analytic.name="altiward.agent_silent" | stats latest(activity_id) as last by finding_info.uid host | where last=1 | stats dc(host) as Macs

panel.title: Without a grant in the period

search.query: where started >= relative_time(now(), "$period$") AND source="Without a grant" | stats count
where started >= relative_time(now(), "$period$") | where isnotnull(source) | eval _time=started | timechart span=1d count by source | where _time >= relative_time(now(), "$period$@d")

panel.title: Time held against time allowed (median per elevation that ended)

search.query: where started >= relative_time(now(), "$period$") AND source="Privileges" AND isnotnull(ended) AND isnotnull(expires) | eval held=(ended - started) / 60, allowed=(expires - started) / 60, early=if(ended <= expires - 60, 1, 0) | stats count as Elevations median(held) as held median(allowed) as allowed avg(early) as early by source | eval "Median held (min)"=round(held, 1), "Median allowed (min)"=round(allowed, 1), "Gave back early (%)"=round(early * 100, 0) | fields source Elevations "Median held (min)" "Median allowed (min)" "Gave back early (%)" | rename source as Source
where started >= relative_time(now(), "$period$") | stats count as Elevations dc(mac) as Macs by person | sort - Elevations | head 5 | rename person as Person
where started >= relative_time(now(), "$period$") | stats count as Elevations dc(person) as People by mac | sort - Elevations | head 5 | rename mac as Mac

index="$index$" sourcetype="altiward:ocsf" class_uid=2004 activity_id=1 | stats count as Findings dc(host) as Macs by finding_info.title severity | sort - Findings | rename finding_info.title as Finding, severity as Severity

index="$index$" sourcetype="altiward:ocsf" class_uid=2004 finding_info.analytic.name="altiward.tamper.*" unmapped.altiward.detail.state!="detected" | stats latest(activity_id) as last latest(finding_info.title) as check latest(severity) as severity min(_time) as since by finding_info.uid host | where last=1 | stats dc(host) as Macs min(since) as since by check severity | eval Since=strftime(since, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | fields check severity Macs Since | rename check as Check, severity as Severity

panel.title: Agent versions (Macs that sent an event in the period)

search.query: index="$index$" sourcetype="altiward:ocsf" host!="altiward" metadata.product.version=* | stats latest(metadata.product.version) as Version by host | stats count as Macs by Version | sort - Version
